title: Manage workplace safety and emergency readiness
summary: When operating premises, employing people in physical work or changing workplace hazards. An owned hazard-control and emergency plan with training, inspections and corrective actions recorded.
outcomes: An owned hazard-control and emergency plan with training, inspections and corrective actions recorded.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When operating premises, employing people in physical work or changing workplace hazards.

parts.title: Inventory work activities and hazards
parts.guidance: Identify premises, equipment, materials, travel and remote-work arrangements along with people exposed. Capture reported concerns and existing incidents without assuming an office has no safety risks.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assess requirements with competent local specialists
parts.guidance: Management and qualified safety advisers determine applicable standards, assessments and responsibilities. Identify urgent hazards and pause unsafe work while required controls are unresolved.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Assess requirements with competent local specialists

parts.title: Approve and implement practical controls
parts.guidance: Assign elimination, engineering, procedural and protective measures appropriate to the hazards. Confirm equipment, emergency access, first-response arrangements and worker consultation with the relevant specialists.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the physical work and checks described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Train people and exercise emergency procedures
parts.guidance: Workers complete their own instruction and supervised practice where required. Conduct approved drills and checks without exposing participants to uncontrolled hazards.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the physical work and checks described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Train people and exercise emergency procedures

parts.title: Inspect controls and close corrective actions
parts.guidance: Track inspections, equipment maintenance, near misses and worker feedback. Verify fixes with competent owners and reassess when activities, locations or applicable requirements change.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An owned hazard-control and emergency plan with training, inspections and corrective actions recorded.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

metadata.supportReason: An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.
